description:
BETWEEN JOBS is a 21-day guided prayer journal for the weeks after a layoff, a firing, or a contract that ended.

Losing a job can shake far more than your bank balance: your routine, your confidence, and your answer to "what do you do?" This journal gives you ten steady minutes a day to bring all of it to God, honestly.

EACH DAY HAS ONE PAGE
- A Bible verse, printed in full
- A short reflection (about a minute to read)
- Two honest questions with room to write
- A prayer starter you finish in your own words

THE THREE WEEKS
1. Shaken: saying what happened, and remembering you are more than a job title
2. Carried: provision, people and rest while you look
3. Next steps: asking, trying again, and using your gifts

WHAT YOU GET
- {{PAGES}} pages: 21 daily pages, 3 weekly pause pages, a beginning and a closing page, and a 2-page prayer list
- 2 PDF files: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4
- Clean pages that are easy on printer ink

A THOUGHTFUL GIFT
If a friend or family member has just lost their job, you can print this and give it with a note, or forward the file today. It never tells the reader a job is guaranteed.

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped. After you pay, download the PDFs and print at home or at a print shop. You can also write on the pages in a tablet notes app such as GoodNotes or Notability.

GOOD TO KNOW
- This journal is a companion for prayer and reflection. It is not financial, legal, career or mental-health advice.
- Scripture is quoted from the World English Bible (WEB), a public-domain modern English translation. Where the WEB uses the name Yahweh, many translations print "the LORD".
- Written from a Christian point of view, with no particular denomination assumed.
- For personal use. If you lead a job-seekers group or care ministry, the group license listing covers printing for up to 25 people.

Because this is a digital file, returns are not possible, but if anything is wrong with your download, message us and we will make it right.
disclosure: How this was made: this journal was planned, written and laid out with the help of AI tools, then read, edited and approved page by page by a person. Scripture is quoted directly from the World English Bible and was not generated.
